author: Rahul Sharma
comment: Got my iPhone 16 from The Mobile Lounge at a better price than Amazon and Flipkart! Bajaj EMI process took only 7 minutes and Vishal bhai gave a free smartwatch and premium tempered glass. Best shop in Kakod!

author: Amit Kumar
comment: Exchanged my old OnePlus 9 Pro and got ₹18,500 instant discount on S24 Ultra. The store team transferred all my 40GB WhatsApp chats and photos completely free. 100% genuine sealed pack with GST bill.

author: Pooja Verma
comment: Saw their reels on Instagram (@themobilelounge_kakod) and drove down from Dankaur. Camera is unbelievable for portrait photos. Got ₹0 downpayment on IDFC bank card easily. Highly recommended!

author: Deepak Nagar
comment: Very polite behaviour and transparent pricing. No hidden fees or extra charges for credit card swipe. The genuine brand warranty and in-store support give full peace of mind. Kakod's top mobile lounge!

author: Vikas Bhati
comment: Bought on 9 months No Cost EMI with Home Credit. Approval was done on spot with just Aadhaar OTP. Also got free noise-cancelling earbuds with it. Best mobile store in Bulandshahr district.
